info.title: Burgertown
info.description:
HTTP APIs for Burgertown on Oak Street, a fictional smash-burger restaurant.
Import this document into Atlas (or any workflow generator). Burgertown is the dummy merchant; Atlas owns blast radius and workflow generation.

Money is integer cents. Tax is 8.5% of (subtotal − discount − reward_discount). Delivery fee is not taxed.
POST /v1/payments requires amount_cents equal to check.totals.due_cents. Redeeming an offer changes due — re-fetch the check or you get 422 amount_mismatch.
The only retryable error is 503 no_courier_available (x-retryable on that response).
Processor payment_method: pm_ok | pm_decline (402) | pm_timeout (504).
Reset fixtures with POST /v1/sandbox { "reset": true } before scripted flows.
Workflow recipes: GET /arazzo.yaml (Arazzo 1.0.1).

Seeded happy-path ids: loc_oak, tbl_4 / chk_ok (due 1736), gst_maya (1240 gold), emp_jon, itm_townie, pm_ok, off_free_fries, dlv_pending, crr_sam.

tags.name: Locations
tags.description: Restaurants this merchant operates. Oak Street is the seeded store.

tags.name: Floor
tags.description: Picnic tables. A table may point at the current open check. Dine-in fulfillments occupy tables.

tags.name: Zones
tags.description: Delivery catchment around Oak Street. Core is $3.49 / 25m; edge is $5.99 / 45m and needs a photo on drop-off.

tags.name: Menus
tags.description: Published menus for a location, grouped into categories.

tags.name: Catalog
tags.description: Sellable items and prices. Filter with exclude_allergens= to hide tagged items.

tags.name: Modifiers
tags.description: Groups with required/min/max rules, quantity caps, 86'd options, and incompatibility pairs.

tags.name: Allergens
tags.description: Tags on items and modifiers. Guest dietary profiles warn or block (strict) on add-item.

tags.name: Taxes
tags.description: Tax rates applied when a check is totaled. Delivery fee is not taxed.

tags.name: Discounts
tags.description: Comps and coupons applied to a check before payment. Stacks with rewards.

tags.name: Inventory
tags.description: 86-lists for items and modifiers. Ordering an 86'd item or option fails.

tags.name: Guests
tags.description: Guests who join Townie Rewards, attach to a check, or save a delivery address.

tags.name: Addresses
tags.description: Guest drop-off points used by zones, quotes, and delivery fulfillments.

tags.name: Employees
tags.description: Staff who open checks and clock in. Server_id is required on new checks.

tags.name: Fulfillment
tags.description: How an order leaves the kitchen: dine-in, pickup, or delivery. Sits between the floor and the check.

tags.name: Checks
tags.description: Open tickets hanging off a fulfillment. Pass table_id to auto-create dine-in, or fulfillment_id directly.

tags.name: Orders
tags.description: Line items with selections[]. Legacy modifier_ids still accepted. Send confirms kitchen + inventory.

tags.name: Kitchen
tags.description: KDS tickets. Last ticket bumped to done marks the fulfillment ready. Three states only.

tags.name: Couriers
tags.description: Riders. crr_sam is the happy path. crr_dee is offline. crr_flake rejects on accept.

tags.name: Delivery
tags.description: Quotes, jobs, pickup, drop-off, fail, cancel. Quote is side-effect free and expires in five minutes.

tags.name: Dispatch
tags.description: Assign a courier. No available rider is the only retryable failure in the catalog (503).

tags.name: Tracking
tags.description: GeoJSON pings on an in-flight delivery. Longitude first.

tags.name: Payments
tags.description: Tender a check. amount_cents must equal current due — redeeming an offer first is the stale-due trap.

tags.name: Processor
tags.description: Card processor charges and refunds. Payments call this after a pending tender is created.

tags.name: Invoices
tags.description: Posted onto a check after capture. Closes the fulfillment. Delivery invoices require status delivered.

tags.name: Receipts
tags.description: Itemized receipt shown after invoice. Tip CTA lives here.

tags.name: Tips
tags.description: Server tip on a captured payment, or courier tip on a delivery. Each is once-only and settles on a different line.

tags.name: Refunds
tags.description: Guest refund request. Burgertown accepts, then Processor reverses, then Voids the check.

tags.name: Voids
tags.description: Voided check confirmation returned after a completed refund pipeline.

tags.name: Gift Cards
tags.description: Stored value that can tender a check instead of card.

tags.name: Rewards
tags.description: Townie Rewards ledger and tiers. Earn after payment. Offers spend points and change check due.

tags.name: Offers
tags.description: Redeemable rewards. Filter with guest_id= to hide ineligible and expired offers.

tags.name: Redemptions
tags.description: Apply an offer to an open check. Changes due_cents and bumps version — re-fetch before paying.

tags.name: Webhooks
tags.description: Subscriptions for payment, order, refund, delivery, reward, and fulfillment events.

tags.name: Settlements
tags.description: End-of-day batches. Server tips and courier tips are separate lines.

tags.name: Reports
tags.description: Sales rollup. group_by=fulfillment_type splits dine-in / pickup / delivery.

tags.name: Meta
tags.description: API index and health

tags.name: Checkout
tags.description: Submit checkout items to Atlas

tags.name: Sandbox
tags.description: Reset seeded store data

post.summary: Submit an item to the Atlas demo ordering workflow
post.description: Submit once per item unit. Use a new order_id for a new submission; reuse the same order_id and item_id when retrying. Burger Town forwards order_id as both the Atlas intake idempotencyKey and payload.order_id, alongside item_id, server_id=emp_jon and location_id=loc_oak. The demo workflow uses order_id as the business key for its four write steps. Reusing an ID with different input is a conflict. This route returns the final capability's JSON response.

order_id.description: Stable identity for this item submission, preserved across retries.

200.description: Final workflow capability response; the demo returns a check and ticket.

409.description: Conflicting reuse of an order ID or Atlas workflow unavailable.

502.description: Atlas unreachable, workflow execution failed, or invalid final response.

504.description: Atlas response timed out. Retry with the same order_id and item_id.

default.description: Atlas rejected the request; its HTTP status is preserved.
